question: Should OpenClaw establish `auth` as a new public top-level CLI namespace despite the existing canonical `models auth` namespace and plugin-root collision semantics?
rationale: The choice creates a durable public command contract and determines whether core or plugins own the `auth` root; tests cannot decide that product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Keep the models namespace
options.body: Decline this alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single supported source of truth, improving discoverability without another command root.

options.title: Sponsor the auth namespace
options.body: Explicitly accept the top-level namespace and require stable ownership rules, conditional documentation, and live fresh-install and plugin-collision proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep the models namespace
recommendation.body: Decline this alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single supported source of truth, improving discoverability without another command root.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the canonical auth-listing command and its intended CLI placement.
